title: Atmospheric carbon dioxide at Mauna Loa
caption: Annual mean CO₂ has risen from about 317 ppm in 1960 to 414 ppm in 2020, and the rise is accelerating. The yearly wiggle is the Northern Hemisphere's plants taking up CO₂ in summer and releasing it in winter. Fitted to NOAA annual means; seasonal cycle ±3 ppm.
alt: CO₂ concentration against year from 1958 to 2023: a curve rising from about 315 to 420 ppm with a small seasonal oscillation.
description: 2020: 414 ppm; a seasonal swing of about 6 ppm each year.

also.lesson: The Earth's atmosphere and climate change
